measurement: /usr/bin/time -lp; sequential builds in a new private Neri object cache; OS caches not cleared

installedIntegration.method: sumi prepare-console followed by two sumi c invocations with stdin at EOF; each exited 0; both openings reported app ready; existing global caches were not cleared

limitations: Single sequential observations, not latency percentiles. Frontend still processes the whole project. Includes arena checkpoints and packed payload cache keys. Sumi preparation uses a fresh staging path, which can invalidate object keys conservatively. Integration includes application initialization and EOF shutdown, not interactive submission latency.
